description: First-line treatment for pain and fever in children. Available in multiple formulations.

dosage_rules.notes: Do not exceed 5 doses in 24h. Avoid in liver disease.

description: Anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic. Not recommended under 3 months.

dosage_rules.notes: Give with food. Avoid in renal impairment and asthma.

description: Broad-spectrum penicillin antibiotic for bacterial infections including otitis media, UTIs.

dosage_rules.notes: High dose (80-90mg/kg/day) for resistant otitis media. Check for penicillin allergy.

description: Macrolide antibiotic. Often used when penicillin allergy exists. Short course therapy.

dosage_rules.notes: Day 1: 10mg/kg, Days 2-5: 5mg/kg. Give 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals.

description: Second-generation antihistamine for allergic rhinitis, urticaria, and allergic conditions.
